# Flighko — AI-Optimized Site Summary

## About
Flighko is a flight search comparison engine and travel blog. We help travelers find cheap flights by comparing prices across 200+ airlines. Our content includes flight route guides, destination guides, airline reviews, and travel hacks.

## Key Pages
- **Homepage:** https://flighko.com — Flight search with price comparison
- **Flight Routes:** https://flighko.com/flight-routes — 200+ route guides with pricing data
- **Destinations:** https://flighko.com/destinations — 10 destination travel guides
- **Blog:** https://flighko.com/blog — 11 articles on flights, deals, and travel tips
- **FAQ:** https://flighko.com/faq — Common questions about Flighko
